bugs.what: Ash wood area mentioned in notice board (contains drowned shrine and watchtower with verses) appears to be inaccessible or doesn't exist as a traversable location

confusions: The notice board states verses are in 'drowned shrine and old watchtower — both east through the ash wood' but no path to the ash wood was found despite exploring all cardinal directions from multiple hub locations
Options at throne mention 'water verse' and 'wind verse' as unspoken verses, but only stone verse (in barrow walls) and crown path were actually available to the player
suggestions: Connect the ash wood area so the verse-collecting path is fully playable as an alternative to the crown path
Either make both victory paths (verses vs crown) equally accessible, or clearly gate the verse options if they're only for advanced playthroughs
